qualifications: Scientific acceptance concerns source definitions, numerical frame construction, projection and qualified evidence. Final PPTX packaging and desktop PowerPoint playback are separate checks.

The capture implementer also authored this scientific synthesis. Numerical acceptance uses independent SciPy/OpenCV recomposition, and the parent reviewed selected actual Unity frames and isolation; this is not a claim of fully independent capture authorship.

Measured is a saved solver state after landmark preparation. It does not establish a raw observation: R7 frames 705-707 have missing raw wrist depth, interpolated input, and measured right-arm solver tags. No object-assisted recovery execution is claimed for those frames.

Input-photo triads use stricter raw-point validity plus saved-state checks. Fresh Unity model axes describe displayed model bases at rendered origins; the pelvis origin is not anatomical L24. No observed wrist orientation is introduced.

New Unity replay uses recording-specific five-length sizing and original display smoothing. Printed recovery states precede display smoothing. Receiver spheres are binary live/non-live; solid RGB strokes encode axis identity, not state.

R7 retains 7 PASS / 1 FAIL from the original Unity diagnostic. The failure is its historical R5-specific failure-concentration expectation, not a failed axis or exact application test. R5 retains 8 PASS / 0 FAIL. Neither result establishes anatomical accuracy.

Fresh R7 retains source frames 0-1497, excluding terminal streamed frame 1498. Fresh R5 retains 0-2097, excluding terminal streamed frame 2098. Capture ran at quarter speed; exports use original 30 fps source time.

Always-visible in-engine axes are explanatory overlays. Mesh/object rendering is unchanged. Raster checks sample retained stills, excluding documented short, offscreen or covered strokes; they are not exhaustive anatomical registration tests.

Page 29 photo triads are L24 and MappedMarker. Its lower circle is an endpoint-aligned construction view of points computed in Camera-prime, not an additional calibrated frame or observed elbow path. No selected recovery elbow is fabricated.
Fresh qualitative replay does not inherit archived Table 7.4 discrepancy metrics. Archived imperfect image pairs and their numerical evidence remain separate.
Pending recording placeholders remain on pages 34, 36 and 38. A placeholder is not recorded evidence.
